question: The term Stumping is related to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Stumping is a term used in cricket when the wicket-keeper catches the ball and removes the bails before the batsman can return to the crease.
 
• It is a common way of dismissing batsmen in cricket.
 
• Stumps
 
 
• Three vertical posts serve as the stumps and hold up two bails. At each end of the pitch, a wicket is created by the combination of the stumps and bails, which are typically constructed of wood, most frequently ash.
 
• Each stump is identified with a unique name:
 
 
• Off stump is the stump that is on the other side of the wicket from the batsman.
 
• The middle of the three stumps is referred to as the middle stump.
 
• The leg stump is the stump that is on the same side as the batsman's legs as the wicket.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In baseball, a similar term is used called "tagging out" where a fielder touches the base with the ball before the runner reaches it.
 
• In tennis, stumping has no relevance as it is an individual sport and there is no wicket-keeper involved.-Basketball also has no relation to stumping as there are no wickets or bails involved in the game.
